metrics.label: Structure zones
metrics.gloss: the ACTIVE structure-zone set (fair-value gaps and order blocks), each used up by a wick past its far edge

metrics.label: Nearest support zone high
metrics.gloss: the high of the nearest support zone (fair-value gap or order block) price has not traded below — the zone's near edge; at a completed bar, the zone in force when the bar opened, picked against its open, and read live on the forming bar, where the price decides which zone is nearest

metrics.label: Nearest support zone low
metrics.gloss: the low of the nearest support zone (fair-value gap or order block) price has not traded below — the zone's far edge, which a low below uses up; at a completed bar, the zone in force when the bar opened, picked against its open, and read live on the forming bar, where the price decides which zone is nearest

metrics.label: Nearest support zone midpoint
metrics.gloss: the midpoint, (high + low) / 2, of the nearest support zone (fair-value gap or order block) price has not traded below — the zone this side's edges read (SMC's fair-value-gap split, ICT's 50% / consequent encroachment), never the rule that picks it; at a completed bar, the zone in force when the bar opened, picked against its open, and read live on the forming bar, where the price decides which zone is nearest

metrics.label: Nearest resistance zone midpoint

metrics.label: Swing high (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the high of the most recent swing high — at or above the 2 highs before it and strictly above the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivothigh tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing high, or until it leaves reach

metrics.label: Swing low (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the low of the most recent swing low — at or below the 2 lows before it and strictly below the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivotlow tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing low, or until it leaves reach

metrics.label: Prior swing high (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the high of the decided swing high before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing high with

metrics.label: Prior swing low (fractal 2/2)
metrics.gloss: the low of the decided swing low before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing low with

metrics.label: Swing high age (bars)
metrics.gloss: the bars from the most recent swing high's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

metrics.label: Swing low age (bars)
metrics.gloss: the bars from the most recent swing low's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

metrics.label: Swing structure
metrics.gloss: the most recent decided swing pivot (2 bars each side) against the previous pivot on its own side: HH or LH for a swing high (an equal high is LH), HL or LL for a swing low (an equal low is HL), none when no comparable pair is in reach — a state held between pivots, not an event

metrics.label: Internal structure break (internal 5, swing 50)
metrics.gloss: the internal structure's break on this bar — BOS when the close crosses its latest uncrossed level with the bias, CHoCH against it — over pivots of length 5, unless the level is also the swing level of length 50; absent on a bar with no break — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

metrics.label: Internal structure trend (internal 5, swing 50)
metrics.gloss: the direction of the internal structure's latest break, over pivots of length 5, unless the level is also the swing level of length 50 — a state held between breaks, absent before the first break the bars prove — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

metrics.label: Internal structure level (internal 5, swing 50)

metrics.label: Pending internal high (internal 5, swing 50)
